priorBlockedAttempt.diagnosis: CIM identified PID 16880 as Windows LockApp in session 1. This does not establish an application click-through defect. DOM and native visibility checks cannot substitute for physical input verification.
priorBlockedAttempt.initialRunIssue: The full run hit the old three-argument Click caller against the new four-argument guarded helper. The fresh worker used the synchronized caller/helper and reached the explicit owner refusal.
priorBlockedAttempt.manualFollowup: Unlock the desktop and leave the physical mouse idle; rerun the unchanged physical assertions. Do not dismiss LockApp or bypass desktop security.

physicalInput.manualFollowup: The listed physical demo checks are complete according to the user. Automated native pointer interference remains a test-harness limitation; no automated pass is claimed.

bugsFoundAndFixed.finding: An existing-user regression started with a fresh profile and waited for an inert dashboard beneath onboarding.
bugsFoundAndFixed.fix: Seed only the absent isolated completed profile through the shared helper; onboarding tests still launch fresh.

bugsFoundAndFixed.finding: The cancellation observation crossed the ordinary 15:00 daily reminder boundary. Pending retry was already false.
bugsFoundAndFixed.fix: Use existing settings to isolate manual retries from normal working-hour slots and wait for native dashboard visibility; retain original retry and geometry assertions.

bugsFoundAndFixed.finding: A helper update and an already-loaded caller were out of sync during the full run; unrestricted click injection could hit another process.
bugsFoundAndFixed.fix: Require isolated owner PID in all Click callers; guard requested cursor and native root-window ownership before SendInput.

bugsFoundAndFixed.finding: Fresh-profile startup and a capture during the 90 ms approved pose crossfade.
bugsFoundAndFixed.fix: Launch the existing-user fixture and wait only for finite animations before screenshots, preserving infinite idle animation.
